name: 67217 · Wichita, KS
findings: ZIP 67217 (Wichita) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67217 (Wichita) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 67217 (Wichita) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
